description: This file implements the SimpleBufferPool class, which manages a pool of static buffers for efficient memory allocation and deallocation, including handling dynamic fallback. It includes buffer initialization, allocation, and deallocation logic, with thread safety measures.

classes.name: SimpleBufferPool
classes.description: A class that manages a pool of static buffers for efficient memory management, with fallback to dynamic memory allocation.

methods.name: SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the static buffer pool with predefined buffer sizes and metadata.

methods.name: ~SimpleBufferPool
methods.description: Destructor that releases the allocated static buffer.

methods.name: allocateImpl
methods.description: Allocates a buffer of the requested size from the static pool if available, otherwise falls back to dynamic malloc.

methods.name: deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates a buffer, returning it to the static pool if it belongs there, or freeing it if dynamically allocated.
